summary: Tested all 6 requested features (backend pytest + Playwright UI). Everything works end to end: corretor 60-day edit lock (locked button + toast, edit/save of recent sales returns 200 with 'Venda atualizada!', so the old 404 is fixed), the 5 new infra options, multiple 'Outro' entries (add/del/persist), gallery drag-and-drop reorder (Capa badge, persists after reload), corretor Resumo 'Informações técnicas' section, and Base IA extraction with the real OpenAI key (33 suggestion rows across all 5 sections + detailed resumo; apply merges specs + adds knowledge item 'Arquivo: <filename>'). One display bug: values the AI returns are saved without being normalized to the values the form and the corretor view expect.

minor.issue: AI values are saved as-is, without normalizing them to the values the form expects. Seen in a real run: comercial.correcao='IPCA' (the form and CORRECAO map expect 'ipca'), so the Correção row is hidden in the corretor view and the Select shows blank. juros_pct='0,5% a.m.' is shown as 'Com juros (0,5% a.m.%)'. baloes_qtd='semestrais' is shown as 'semestrais balão(ões)'. Numbers come back as numbers in some runs (area_total 120000 with no unit; prazo_construcao '36' with no unit).

ui_bugs.issue: The Correção row is hidden when the value is uppercase 'IPCA'/'IGPM' (case-sensitive lookup in CORRECAO). 'Juros' always adds '%' even if juros_pct already contains '%'.

issues: The Vendas table overflows horizontally and the first column ('Data') is clipped at the left edge, even on a desktop viewport

Infra items the AI extracts that are not in INFRA_OPTIONS (e.g., 'Quadra de tênis') are stored in infraestrutura.items. They are not shown as checkboxes, so the gestor cannot remove them from the form. Consider mapping them into 'outros'.

action_items: Normalize AI extract values (backend after the AI call or in LoteamentoKnowledge before apply): lowercase correcao/juros/balao/obra.status/tipo; strip '%' from juros_pct/liberacao_pct/percentual; make baloes_qtd numeric; send values not in INFRA_OPTIONS to infraestrutura.outros
CorretorLoteamentoView: case-insensitive CORRECAO lookup; do not add '%' when juros_pct already contains it
Fix horizontal clipping of the corretor sales table's first column
critical_code_review_comments: reorder_lot_images: no Pydantic validation of body; one update_one per id (fine for <300 images, could use bulk_write)
_lot_gallery_text sorts by created_at only, not by the new 'order', so the AI's gallery description ignores the user's ordering
ai_extract truncates text to 90k chars, and image fallback only covers the first 12 pages; very long books are partially read (acceptable, but worth documenting)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 medium display bug from AI value normalization
